# Reorderable list (`reorderable-list`)

Drag to reorder.

Group: Layout & shells. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/layout';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createReorderableList` (types in `dist/web/layout/reorderableList.d.ts`): `.mh-reorder` (`.is-sorting` while dragging): a list (`__list`) of rows (`__item`, `.is-dragging`, `.is-grabbed`) with a drag `__handle` (`aria-pressed` while picked up from the keyboard), an `__icon`, the `__text` (`__label`, `__description`) and a `__trailing` slot; SR-only instructions and a `__live` region.

```ts
export function createReorderableList(options: ReorderableListOptions): ReorderableListHandle;

export interface ReorderableListOptions {
  items: readonly ReorderableItem[];
  /** Accessible name of the list. */
  label: string;
  messages?: Partial<ReorderMessages>;
  /** The new order of ids, after every drop or keyboard move. */
  onChange?: (ids: string[]) => void;
}

export interface ReorderableListHandle extends ReorderController {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  order(): string[];
  setItems(items: readonly ReorderableItem[]): void;
}

export interface ReorderableItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** An element at the end of the row (a switch, a count). */
  trailing?: HTMLElement;
}
```

`createStack` (types in `dist/web/layout/stack.d.ts`): `.mh-stack`: children in a column or (`--row`) a row, spaced by `--mh-space-*` (`--gap-<step>`, default `md`).

```ts
export function createStack(options: StackOptions = {}, ...children: Child[]):;

export interface StackOptions {
  /** `column` (default) or `row`. */
  direction?: 'column' | 'row';
  gap?: Space;
  align?: StackAlign;
  justify?: StackJustify;
  /** Rows wrap onto more lines. */
  wrap?: boolean;
  /** Element to render (default `div`). */
  as?: 'div' | 'section' | 'ul' | 'ol' | 'nav' | 'header' | 'footer';
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createReorderableList, createStack, createText } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const rooms = ['Living room', 'Kitchen', 'Hall', 'Bedroom', 'Office'];
const order = createText(`Order: ${rooms.join(', ')}`, { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });

const list = createReorderableList({
  label: 'Room order on the dashboard',
  items: rooms.map((room) => ({ id: room, label: room, icon: 'home' })),
  // Ids are the room names here, so the new order reads directly.
  onChange: (ids) => (order.textContent = `Order: ${ids.join(', ')}`),
});

document.body.append(createStack({ gap: 'md' }, list.el, order).el);
```

## React API

`ReorderableList` (types in `dist/react/layout.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createReorderableList`; dragging, keys and announcements come from `bindReorderableList`.

```ts
export function ReorderableList({ items, label, messages, onChange, className }: ReorderableListProps);

export interface ReorderableListProps {
  items: readonly ReorderableListItem[];
  label: string;
  messages?: Partial<ReorderMessages>;
  /** The new order of ids after every move. The list keeps its own order and follows `items` when they change. */
  onChange?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  className?: string;
}

export interface ReorderableListItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailing?: ReactNode;
}
```

```ts
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ReorderableList, Stack, Text } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

// Kept outside the component: the list follows `items` whenever a new array arrives.
const ROOMS = ['Living room', 'Kitchen', 'Hall', 'Bedroom', 'Office'].map((room) => ({ id: room, label: room, icon: 'home' }));

export function ReorderableListExample() {
  const [order, setOrder] = useState(ROOMS.map((room) => room.id));
  return (
    <Stack gap="md">
      <ReorderableList label="Room order on the dashboard" items={ROOMS} onChange={setOrder} />
      <Text variant="caption" tone="muted">
        Order: {order.join(', ')}
      </Text>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```
